text: You see Rae.
source_text: You see Rae.

text: You see a super mutant.
source_text: You see a super mutant.

text: You don't belong here.
source_text: You don't belong here.

text: (seems confused and sad) I believe I do, but.. why are you here?
source_text: (seems confused and sad) I believe I do, but.. why are you here?

text: Neither do you.
source_text: Neither do you.

text: Uh.. yes I do. The master is having me scout around in disguise to check our security.
source_text:
Uh.. yes I do. The master is having me scout around in disguise
 to check our security.

text: Yes I do, I'm here to kill you.
source_text: Yes I do, I'm here to kill you.

text: Okay, I'm leaving.
source_text: Okay, I'm leaving.

text: huh.
source_text: huh.

text: (sigh) What do you want now?
source_text: (sigh) What do you want now?

text: I'm lost.. can you show me how to get to the master? I need to kill him.
source_text:
I'm lost.. can you show me how to get to the master? I need to kill
 him.

text: Nothing. Goodbye.
source_text: Nothing. Goodbye.

text: To see what you look like with all your skin ripped off your body, you mutant scum.
source_text:
To see what you look like with all your skin ripped off your body,
 you mutant scum.

text: What's wrong with you?
source_text: What's wrong with you?

text: great oogly moogly.
source_text: great oogly moogly.

text: I'm here to... contemplate the oneness of the master.
source_text: I'm here to... contemplate the oneness of the master.

text: Of course. The unity brings peace. May I ask where you are from?
source_text: Of course. The unity brings peace. May I ask where you are from?

text: I am as well. I made the pilgrimage from far away to see the master with my own eyes.
source_text:
I am as well. I made the pilgrimage from far away to see the master
 with my own eyes.

text: I have much to learn. How does one gain an audience with the master?
source_text: I have much to learn. How does one gain an audience with the master?

text: I did that yesterday. Today I'm contemplating what the master would look like if I lit him on fire and roasted marshmallows over his putrid carcass.
source_text:
I did that yesterday. Today I'm contemplating what the master would
 look like if I lit him on fire and roasted marshmallows over his putrid
 carcass.

text: I think the master is insane.
source_text: I think the master is insane.

text: I'm from... somewhere ..else.
source_text: I'm from... somewhere ..else.

text: What a coincidence! So am I.
source_text: What a coincidence! So am I.

text: Where?
source_text: Where?

text: I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.
source_text: I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.

text: What, are you an imbecile?
source_text: What, are you an imbecile?

text: Where are you from?
source_text: Where are you from?

text: (whispers) I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.
source_text: (whispers) I'm from a vault... I'm a pure strain human.

text: I'd rather not say. Goodbye.
source_text: I'd rather not say. Goodbye.

text: A small village to the north of here.
source_text: A small village to the north of here.

text: Why should I tell you? You're just a lackey for the 'Man'.
source_text: Why should I tell you? You're just a lackey for the 'Man'.

text: Why would you tell me that? I should take you before the master...
source_text: Why would you tell me that? I should take you before the master...

text: But you won't
source_text: But you won't

text: You're welcome to try.
source_text: You're welcome to try.

text: Well, I should shove my gun down your throat and pull the trigger!
source_text: Well, I should shove my gun down your throat and pull the trigger!

text: Please don't.
source_text: Please don't.

text: I know why you're in so much pain.
source_text: I know why you're in so much pain.

text: I'll be going now.
source_text: I'll be going now.

text: You're right... if only I could clear my head. There's something...
source_text: You're right... if only I could clear my head. There's something...

text: I know why you can't clear your head.
source_text: I know why you can't clear your head.

text: The master keeps you from thinking clearly. Thinking disturbs the unity.
source_text:
The master keeps you from thinking clearly. Thinking disturbs the
 unity.

text: The master is the reason you are in such pain.
source_text: The master is the reason you are in such pain.

text: Hey, I've got an idea - let's cut open the master and see what's inside!!!
source_text:
Hey, I've got an idea - let's cut open the master and see what's
 inside!!!

text: Tell me! Please!!
source_text: Tell me! Please!!

text: You used to be human, too. The master dipped you in the FEV virus and mutated you.
source_text:
You used to be human, too. The master dipped you in the FEV virus and
 mutated you.

text: Sorry, I can't.
source_text: Sorry, I can't.

text: Only the master can tell you everything.
source_text: Only the master can tell you everything.

text: Only the master can tell you everything. But you'd better talk to him quick, 'cause I'm on my way to kill him.
source_text:
Only the master can tell you everything. But you'd better talk to him
 quick, 'cause I'm on my way to kill him.

text: Sorry, got to go.
source_text: Sorry, got to go.

text: I should kill you for taunting me!
source_text: I should kill you for taunting me!

text: I have a better idea - help me destroy the master for doing this to you.
source_text:
I have a better idea - help me destroy the master for doing this to
 you.

text: No, you should kill the master for doing this to you. I'm on my way to do just that... would you like to join me?
source_text:
No, you should kill the master for doing this to you. I'm on my way
 to do just that... would you like to join me?

text: Why? I'm not the one who turned you into a mutant!
source_text: Why? I'm not the one who turned you into a mutant!

text: You're welcome to try.
source_text: You're welcome to try.

text: No thanks. Bye!
source_text: No thanks. Bye!

text: Let's twist his head until his eyes pop out.
source_text: Let's twist his head until his eyes pop out.

text: You will never kill the master. He cannot die.
source_text: You will never kill the master. He cannot die.

text: You're right. I'd better get out of here.
source_text: You're right. I'd better get out of here.

text: We'll see about that.
source_text: We'll see about that.

text: Hmmm. I wonder how he'll continue to live when his unity is destroyed...
source_text: Hmmm. I wonder how he'll continue to live when his unity is destroyed...

text: That can't be.. the master.. protects... unifies...
source_text: That can't be.. the master.. protects... unifies...

text: Well, you're a living example of 'unification', my friend. I know, I've seen the process. I'm here to stop the master from 'unifying' anyone else.
source_text:
Well, you're a living example of 'unification', my friend. I know,
 I've seen the process. I'm here to stop the master from 'unifying' anyone
 else.

text: How does it feel to be protected and unified?
source_text: How does it feel to be protected and unified?

text: Yeah, he protects himself by controlling everyone else.
source_text: Yeah, he protects himself by controlling everyone else.

text: I've had enough of this. Goodbye.
source_text: I've had enough of this. Goodbye.

text: Leave now or I will be forced to deal with you.
source_text: Leave now or I will be forced to deal with you.

text: AAAUGH!!! (Grabs his head in pain and confusion) I.. can't...
source_text: AAAUGH!!! (Grabs his head in pain and confusion) I.. can't...

text: That's right, your friend the master stripped you of everything you had in this world, including your humanity.
source_text:
That's right, your friend the master stripped you of everything
 you had in this world, including your humanity.

text: You know that it's true... that's why you're so confused. You're fighting the mutation. Help me avenge you by destroying the master!
source_text:
You know that it's true... that's why you're so confused. You're
 fighting the mutation. Help me avenge you by destroying the master!

text: Sure you can. C'mon, let's kill the master, it will be fun.
source_text: Sure you can. C'mon, let's kill the master, it will be fun.

text: I'd better leave.
source_text: I'd better leave.

text: I'm sorry you're in such pain, but it's the master's fault.
source_text: I'm sorry you're in such pain, but it's the master's fault.

text: I will pull his eye out!! I'll tear his slimy little head from its cables!!!! You, ...get out of here... I'll take care of the master.
source_text:
I will pull his eye out!! I'll tear his slimy little head from
 its cables!!!! You, ...get out of here... I'll take care of the master.

text: Great!!
source_text: Great!!

text: Thanks for the offer, but I'd like to do the job myself. Would you like to help?
source_text:
Thanks for the offer, but I'd like to do the job myself. Would
 you like to help?

text: I'm going to stay here. I have some unfinished business.
source_text: I'm going to stay here. I have some unfinished business.
